subject: Manual control GUI beta, ordinary GUI plus explicit-action elevated helper

requestScope.scope: Implement, validate and share user-initiated ReadState, Enable80 and DisableProtection for the already validated model/profile.

validation.testCaseDefinition: Registered regression groups; parameter iterations are not counted as separate tests.
validation.restore: Offline cleared-feed NuGet configuration using the existing local package cache.
validation.failureCorrectedBeforeFinalValidation: A lease path-validation IOException was previously misclassified Busy; Busy now requires an actual CreateNew collision, while path security failures return Unavailable. Final full suite and both builds passed after this correction.
regressionsCover: Unknown, unsupported, wrong-profile, cancelled and stale state never authorizes a setting.
Duplicate requests, cross-operation frames, exceeded stage budgets and repeated setters are rejected.
Actual invocation/output/input join and target close precede result; matching ACK precedes own lease release.
EOF, partial or mismatched frames, failed ACK and missing Released remain uncertain and block further admission.
Transport loss is stop intent for later stages, not SDK cancellation or synthetic completion.
Mock, suspend/resume and late phases/results cannot restore a current mode or enable setting buttons.
Busy close/reclick, UAC cancellation, unchanged-content save suppression and failed-save retry are handled.
Lease file path checks fail closed and existing old-purpose trial markers are not reused.

operationContract.readState: Read mode, upper and lower only.
operationContract.enable80: Fresh mode 0, upper and lower pre-read; semantic 1 at most once; mode/upper/lower post-read must match 1/80/75 for ChangedCandidate.
operationContract.disable: Fresh mode 1; semantic 0 at most once; post-mode must match 0 for ChangedCandidate.
operationContract.alreadyDesiredMode: Stop after first mode read, no setter, thresholds not inferred.
operationContract.comparisonGeneration: One cryptographic fill per comparison; reject zero or duplicate tuples without resampling.
operationContract.leafBinding: Same attempt, operation, stage index, frame, target, observer and owned input.

workflow: helper releases only its own new lease
guiAndHelperBoundary.transportLoss: Reject later admissions; continue waiting for actual in-flight join.

saveUx.observationDuplicateKey: Same observation session and sample count

independentAudit.auditMethod: Independent read-only ZIP, PE/CLI metadata, embedded manifest/BAML, literal project graph/source bytes, build evidence and baseline byte comparison. No product executable, build, test or Windows/OEM runtime executed by this reviewer.

manualFlowReview.note: The GUI assembly contains the pre-existing read-only worker Process.Kill reference. This audit confirms no process kill in the reviewed manual workflow, rather than claiming absence from the entire application. Helper Cancel reference resolves only to CancellationTokenSource for stop admission intent, not an SDK observer Cancel.

independentAudit.runtimeBoundary: The new Windows GUI/helper combination has not been executed on the actual notebook by this reviewer or the cloud build. Readback candidates are not electrical charge-effect confirmation.

runtimeAndSafetyLimits.priorFunctionalEvidence: The previous notebook reports already confirmed suppression at 80% and resumed charging after semantic 1-to-0, reaching 85%. This is distinct from runtime validation of this new GUI/helper combination.
runtimeAndSafetyLimits.nextUserCheck: Extract this single ZIP into a new folder, run the GUI normally, explicitly ReadState first, then optionally the desired Enable80/DisableProtection action; inspect cleanup/readback and save the new manual-control TXT via the adjacent folder button.
